sections.content: The repair plan defines typed, hash-bound skill input selection, complete page coverage, immutable generations, validated current-pointer resolution, and non-authorizing execution gates.
sections.title: Workflow scope

sections.content: VDD prepares plans, the maintainer publishes implementation state, Quick Dev records implementation completion, and Acceptance alone records acceptance completion. Evidence is append-only and fails closed on drift or ambiguity.
sections.title: Lifecycle controls

sections.content: Seven ordered slices require RED, GREEN, and refactor evidence. Validators check path confinement, contract and registry bindings, coverage, source identity, retention behavior, and an end-to-end non-authorizing flow.
